🎥🎬: Family Guy (1999–Present)

The series follows the wildly dysfunctional Griffin family living in the fictional town of Quahog, Rhode Island. Well-meaning but clueless Peter Griffin constantly drags his family into bizarre situations, while his wife Lois, their children Meg, Chris, and the evil genius baby Stewie, along with their talking dog Brian, try to survive the chaos.

From outrageous adventures and pop culture parodies to absurd cutaway gags, the Griffins find themselves dealing with everything from everyday family problems to completely ridiculous scenarios. Despite the nonstop madness, the family always manages to find their way back to one another.

Created by Seth MacFarlane, Family Guy is one of television’s most iconic adult animated sitcoms, known for its sharp humor, unforgettable characters, and fearless satire.

source_details.synopsis: Family Guy is an American animated sitcom created by Seth MacFarlane for the Fox Broadcasting Company. The series premiered on January 31, 1999, following Super Bowl XXXIII, with the rest of the first season airing from April 11, 1999. The show centers around the Griffins, a dysfunctional family consisting of parents Peter and Lois, their children, Meg, Chris, and Stewie, and their anthropomorphic pet dog, Brian. Set in the fictional city of Quahog, Rhode Island, the show exhibits much of its humor in the form of cutaway gags that often lampoon American culture.
